svg.text: How each safety goal and SOTIF measure is verified
WP-S-09 §2, Figure 2-2: each requirement of each safety goal, and the triggering conditions and modifications by kind, with the cases that
verify them, coloured by where each case runs. No case has been run; a chip is a plan, not a result.

or crosswalk against right of way

that are stale, corrupted or not the
